test_title: SSC CPO 2022 Tier-II Official Paper (Held On: 02 May, 2023 Shift 2)
subject: general
question:
**Direction:Select the option that expresses the given sentence in passive voice.**

Nick won the lottery.

options.text: The lottery was won by Nick.
The lottery has been win by Nick.
The lottery is won by Nick
The lottery is being won by Nick

solution:
The correct answer is **"The lottery was won by Nick."**

 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

 
• The given sentence is in Active Voice. As per the given question we have to change it into Passive Voice. 
 
• The structure of the given sentence is as follows:
 
 
• Subject + V2 + Object. (Active Voice)
 
• Subject (objective case)+ was/were + V3 + Object (subjective case). (Passive Voice)
 
 
 
• Example:
 
 
• *Their cousin showed them some rare photographs. (Active Voice)*
 
• *They were shown some rare photographs by their cousin. (Passive Voice)*
 
 
 
• The subject of the given sentence is 'Nick'.​​
 
• The object of the given sentence is 'lottery'. 
 
• The subject will be put in place of the object and the object will be put in place of the subject.
 
• **'Won'** will be changed into 'was won'. 
 
• "Lottery" is a singular noun and we must use "was" with it.
 
• The preposition** "by"** is used to indicate the doer of the action (Nick) in the passive voice.
 
• Therefore, as per the points mentioned above, we find that the correct answer is Option 1.

 ​

Correct sentence: *The lottery was won by Nick.*

5d:T
